title: The 86% habit of couples who last
lines: Can a *bird* tell if you two will last?
Your partner points and says, *look at that bird.*
Couples who lasted turned toward bids *86 percent* of the time.
So be honest: do you look up?

title: What holding hands does to your brain
lines: Whose hand calms your brain *the most*?
Expecting a shock, your brain braces for *fear*.
Holding a stranger's hand? It still braces.
For married women, their husband's hand calmed it *the most*.
And the happier the couple, the *calmer* it stayed.

title: Do couples really start to look alike?
lines: Do couples really start to *look alike*?
Photos of *517 couples*, 20 to 69 years apart, say no.
They did *not* grow more alike over time.
They already looked similar *from the very start*.
So, do you two look alike?
